CSR/CSC graph and numeric storage fixtures generated by generate_connectome_fixtures.py with
pinned h5py3.15.1/numpy2.3.4 (UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/wk-rust-reader-uv, uv --offline). The graph includes
external and self-connections, isolated agglomerate7, variable synapse counts and UInt64MAX positions.

scala_oracle.json and scala_zarr_oracle.json call the actual compiled Scala ConnectomeFileService
and Hdf5ConnectomeFileService / ZarrConnectomeFileService. Generated by GenerateConnectomeFixtures.java,
using datastore target/scala-3.8.4/classes + exported dependencyClasspath, --enable-native-access.
The local vault override supplies the real Scala FileSystemDataVault without credential/RPC dependencies;
DSChunkCacheService uses standalone-datastore.conf. Algorithms and transfer conversion are not mocked.

Canonical HDF5: contiguous earliest, B-tree v1 big-endian gzip+shuffle+Fletcher32, latest chunk-index v4.
Zarr3 canonical arrays: equivalent UInt64 indexes/positions/partners and UInt8 types. Native HDF5 reads
UInt8 255 as255; Scala Zarr MA Byte.getLong widens its signed storage to-1. Boundary goldens: negative,
end and past-end synapse ids fail for HDF5, while Zarr fills0. Duplicate selected IDs preserve request order.

Numeric variants: HDF5 signed Int32 CSR, UInt32 partners, Int16 types and exact whole Float64 positions.
Zarr signed Int32 CSR (multi-pair cast fails), UInt32 partner whose max widens to-1, signed Int16 types,
and fractional/nonfinite Float64 positions narrowed by Java getLong (truncate/clamp/NaN→0).
scala_numeric_oracle.json / scala_zarr_numeric_oracle.json use those exact readers.

set_order_oracle.json: actual Scala .toSet.toSeq, small Set1–4, CHAMP sets and hash collisions; sizes0–128.
This order determines in/out synapse order for multi-agglomerate queries. It is reproduced in Rust.

JHDF5 conversion differs from H5Dread/H5P_DEFAULT: its dataset transfer callback rejects signed-negative
unsigned reads and fractional/sign/range loss, and integer→Float32 precision loss. Actual direct-reader
oracle ../agglomerates/jhdf5_numeric_oracle.json is generated by GenerateHdf5NumericFixtures.java;
InspectJHdf5Conversions.java is the diagnostic helper. Root attributes use H5Aread without that callback.
Native HDF5/Java are oracle-generation dependencies only. Rust runtime and golden replay use no native link.
